VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.97

  • Adds Powerhouse preparation modes so the Companion can proactively warm local STT, local LLM, streaming TTS, route, and network paths.
  • Adds pooled HF speech-to-speech sidecars: the primary/default profile comes online first, then fallback STT profiles are warmed in parallel.
  • Adds an optional realtime priority helper so hot VoiceClaw sidecars and bridge runtime processes can receive elevated scheduling priority.
  • Improves Companion Realtime Voice diagnostics, runtime manifest verification, packaged-app validation, and interrupt-safe TTS streaming behavior.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.96

  • Prepares the Mac as a ready Companion Realtime Voice workstation with recommended local voice dependencies.
  • Adds HF runtime prewarming, broader readiness checks, and selected-profile dependency installation.
  • Standardizes Companion Realtime Voice audio transport on 16 kHz and uses Kokoro CPU TTS with local Qwen to avoid MPS contention.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.95

  • Adds a packaged runtime manifest with Companion version, build, runtime package version, source commit, and runtime hash.
  • Exposes the runtime manifest through bridge health, config, and Realtime status endpoints so the Companion can prove the running bridge matches the installed app runtime.
  • Adds launch-time stale-runtime detection and one-shot self-healing: if the LaunchAgent points at an old runtime or the running bridge reports an old/missing runtime hash, the Companion refreshes and restarts only the bridge LaunchAgent from saved config.
  • Adds a Bridge Runtime diagnostics row and release verification checks so future packages cannot ship without runtime identity metadata.
